_il2cpp.enchantValue: ItemPropertyList._propertyList[]._tiers[]._value — added to the sell price at FACE value
_il2cpp.sellValue: ItemTemplate._sellValue — authored per template, NOT a fixed fraction of _value
_il2cpp.temperMult: ItemTemplate._temperProperties[L-1]._value — a MULTIPLIER on _sellValue for temper level L (1..10); level 0 is 1.0

_meta._sell_price_rule: price = round(sellValue * temperMult(level)) + sum over properties.ENCHANTING of enchantValue[id][tier]; properties.GRADING contributes nothing. Validated at 478/508 exact against retail buybacks.
_meta._source: APK Unity bundles (reference/apk/blades.apk), Unity 2019.4.37f1 il2cpp metadata v24
